actions.title: Read the offline boundary
actions.instruction: Read this public lesson before running a command. The exercise uses local bare repositories and never creates a hosted pull request. The receipt recorder currently requires macOS or Linux; native Windows is not a complete P02 route.
actions.rationale: The learner must distinguish local proof from a hosted collaboration workflow.
actions.expected_result: You can state that this is a public offline-local rehearsal and that native Windows cannot complete the receipt path.
actions.recovery: If you expected a GitHub pull request or hosted CI, stop here and reread the boundary.

actions.title: Prepare the numbered local attempt
actions.instruction: In a native terminal outside the checkout, run Prepare with the absolute learner repository path. Record the printed branch and prepared commit before entering the checkout.
actions.rationale: Prepare establishes the verifier-owned local topology before learner work begins.
actions.expected_result: Academy prints an academy/P02-commit-review-pr/ATTEMPT branch, prepared commit, and two logical repository IDs.
actions.recovery: Preserve any error. Do not run Prepare inside the learner checkout or guess an attempt number.
actions.evidence: The printed identity binds later guards to this attempt.

actions.title: Enter and guard the prepared checkout
actions.instruction: Enter the learner checkout in the native terminal. Compare the printed branch and prepared commit to the live checkout, then inspect status and remotes.
actions.rationale: The guard prevents review or commit work in the wrong repository or attempt.

variants.command:
Set-Location -LiteralPath '<learner-repository>'
git branch --show-current
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
git remote -v

cd '<learner-repository>'
git branch --show-current
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
git remote -v

cd '<learner-repository>'
git branch --show-current
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
git remote -v

actions.expected_result: The branch and HEAD match Prepare, status is clean, and origin and upstream use local exercise routes.
actions.recovery: If any value differs, preserve the output and Reset instead of changing remotes by hand.
actions.evidence: You confirmed the target before generating work evidence.

actions.title: Inspect the prepared exercise change
actions.instruction: Inspect the two prepared paths and read the scenario before staging them. Do not stage a third path.
actions.rationale: The work range is intentionally limited to the two Workshop Queue paths.
actions.expected_result: You can describe the intended two-path patch before staging it.
actions.recovery: If another path is modified, preserve it outside this attempt before continuing.
actions.evidence: The work boundary is visible before the agent reviews it.

actions.title: Stage exactly the reviewed work boundary
actions.instruction: In the native terminal, stage exactly the two Workshop Queue paths and inspect the staged path list before asking the active agent to review.
actions.rationale: The agent reviews and commits the explicit two-path work boundary, never an inferred working-tree change.

variants.command:
git add -- tests/test_cli.py workshop_queue/cli.py
git diff --cached --name-only

git add -- tests/test_cli.py workshop_queue/cli.py
git diff --cached --name-only

git add -- tests/test_cli.py workshop_queue/cli.py
git diff --cached --name-only

actions.expected_result: The staged path list contains exactly tests/test_cli.py and workshop_queue/cli.py.
actions.recovery: If another path appears, preserve it and unstage only that unrelated path before continuing.
actions.evidence: The review boundary is explicit before the active agent sees it.

actions.title: Declare the review boundary
actions.instruction: Tell the active agent to inspect only the staged tests/test_cli.py and workshop_queue/cli.py change. Decide whether its findings are cleared before asking for a commit.
actions.rationale: The learner owns the review decision; Academy does not authenticate it as human approval.
actions.expected_result: You have a bounded review request and a conscious cleared or not-cleared decision.
actions.recovery: If findings remain, correct only the exercise change and review again. Do not declare it cleared early.
actions.evidence: The later receipt records only your cleared declaration.

actions.title: Let the agent run the review gate
actions.instruction: Use the host-native CodeArbiter review command after the learner asks for the bounded review. This is a harness command, never a shell command.
actions.rationale: The review gate produces the agent-side review result without the learner imitating a terminal command.
actions.expected_result: The active agent reports the review result for the staged work boundary.
actions.recovery: If the review gate blocks, preserve the finding and resolve it before the work commit.
actions.evidence: The learner has inspected the review result but Check cannot authenticate who reviewed.

actions.title: Let the agent commit the reviewed work
actions.instruction: After the learner approves the exact two staged paths and clears the review, invoke the host-native CodeArbiter commit gate.
actions.rationale: The work commit remains separate from the later receipt-only commit.
actions.expected_result: One new commit changes only tests/test_cli.py and workshop_queue/cli.py.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve its finding. Do not substitute git commit or amend another attempt.
actions.evidence: The local work range starts after the prepared commit.

actions.title: Prove the work range and push only origin
actions.instruction: In the native terminal, inspect the nonempty one-commit range, push its head to origin, then compare both local bare remotes. Never push upstream.
actions.rationale: The receipt binds the exact work head only after the learner origin contains it.

variants.command:
$branch = git branch --show-current
$workHead = git rev-parse HEAD
git log --oneline "HEAD~1..$workHead"
git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$branch"
git ls-remote upstream "refs/heads/$branch"

branch=$(git branch --show-current)
git log --oneline HEAD~1..HEAD
git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$branch"
git ls-remote upstream "refs/heads/$branch"

branch=$(git branch --show-current)
git log --oneline HEAD~1..HEAD
git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
git ls-remote origin "refs/heads/$branch"
git ls-remote upstream "refs/heads/$branch"

actions.expected_result: Origin reports the attempt work head and upstream reports no attempt ref.
actions.recovery: If origin differs or upstream has the ref, stop and preserve the evidence. Do not force-push or edit the remotes.
actions.evidence: The receipt will bind the origin-only local push proof.

actions.title: Record the declared local receipt
actions.instruction: After deciding the review is cleared, run the installed helper in the native terminal. It writes one untracked canonical receipt and does not stage, commit, or push it.
actions.rationale: The helper formats only recomputable local facts plus the learner declaration.
actions.recovery: If it refuses, preserve the message and use Reset. Do not hand-write a replacement receipt.
actions.evidence: The output says it recorded a learner-declared offline-local review receipt.

actions.title: Stage only the receipt
actions.instruction: Stage the one canonical receipt path and inspect the staged path list before asking the agent to commit it.
actions.rationale: The final commit may contain only the receipt.
actions.expected_result: The staged path list contains exactly .codearbiter/reports/academy/P02-pr-receipt.json.
actions.recovery: If another path appears, preserve it and unstage only that unrelated path before continuing.
actions.evidence: The receipt commitment boundary is explicit.

actions.title: Let the agent commit the receipt
actions.instruction: After the learner approves the one staged receipt path, invoke the host-native CodeArbiter commit gate for the receipt-only commit.
actions.rationale: A separate commit distinguishes reviewed work from the declaration about it.
actions.expected_result: A later commit changes only the receipt path.
actions.recovery: If the gate blocks, preserve the finding. Do not amend the work commit or commit a second path.
actions.evidence: Check expects the receipt commit to have the work head as its sole parent.

actions.title: Confirm the attempt is clean
actions.instruction: Inspect status in the native terminal before Check. A clean worktree means the receipt is committed rather than merely present.
actions.rationale: Check accepts committed evidence, not an uncommitted local file.
actions.recovery: If Git prints a path, preserve the committed attempt and resolve only the uncommitted path. Do not reset completed evidence.
actions.evidence: The checkout matches the receipt commit.

actions.title: Run external Academy Check
actions.instruction: Run the installed Check command from the native terminal. It recomputes the offline-local evidence and records progress only after passing.
actions.rationale: External verification separates accepted Git facts from the learner's local narration.
actions.expected_result: Check reports a passed P02 checkpoint.
actions.recovery: If Check fails, preserve the clean committed attempt and use the named failed predicate to decide whether to Reset.
actions.evidence: Check proves the local graph and receipt structure, not hosted review facts.

actions.title: Preserve and reset an attempt
actions.instruction: Use Reset only for a retry or when directed by a failure message. It archives the current attempt before restoring the original topology.
actions.rationale: Preservation-first recovery keeps failed evidence inspectable.
actions.expected_result: Academy preserves the current attempt and restores original remotes when the sidecar topology matches.
actions.recovery: If Reset refuses, preserve its output and do not force-reset, edit remotes, or delete refs.
actions.evidence: The prior attempt remains reachable for inspection.
